name: debranges-kernels-lehmer-cascade
title: De Branges Reproducing Kernels, the Universal Transverse Square-Cascade for Lehmer Pairs, and the Leibniz-Wronskian Identity for Riemann's Xi-Function
description: Exact De Branges reproducing kernel identity K_alpha(t-id, t-id) = (alpha/pi)*W_tilde(d,t), universal transverse square-cascade c_{2m-1}(t_0) = [m/(m!)^2]*(Xi^{(m)}(t_0))^2 > 0 for order-m critical-line zero coalescence and 2D Lehmer-pair sum-of-squares bowls, and universal Leibniz-Wronskian identity with 0%-overshoot truncated Euler-product sieves closing the Lehmer uncertainty zone.
